title: Suzy Wongs Drag n Brunch Food and Show Included
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Ladies and gentlemen, it's show time! Experience a new way to brunch at Suzy Wong's Drag'n Brunch in Nashville every Friday--Sunday. We are the ONLY Food-Inclusive Drag Brunch in Nashville! We also have the ability to celebrate any Special Occasion for you or members of your party. 
Whether you're celebrating a Birthday, Bachelorette/Bachelor weekend, Going-Away party, Graduation, Divorce, or you just need an excuse to day drink with friends, Suzy Wong's is an unforgettable Nashville drag brunch experience. We are not a traditional restaurant!
